metrics-json.title: Combined sample metrics JSON
metrics-json.description: Machine-readable JSON containing read, alignment, coverage, SNP, SV, contamination, and sex-state metrics available for the sample.

low-coverage-state-json.title: Low coverage rejection state JSON
low-coverage-state-json.description: Machine-readable terminal state record for a sample rejected before analysis because coverage did not meet the configured minimum.

snp-vcf.title: Short variant VCF
snp-vcf.description: VCF file with the SNPs for the sample.

sv-vcf.title: Structural variant VCF
sv-vcf.description: VCF file with the SVs for the sample.

sv-snf.title: Structural variant SNF
sv-snf.description: SNF file with the SVs for the sample, for onward multi-sample SV calling.

cnv-vcf.title: Copy number variants VCF
cnv-vcf.description: VCF file with the CNV for the sample.

mod-bedmethyl.title: Modified bases bedMethyl
mod-bedmethyl.description: BED file with the aggregated modification counts for the sample.

mod-bedmethyl-hap1.title: Modified bases bedMethyl (haplotype 1)
mod-bedmethyl-hap1.description: BED file with the aggregated modification counts for haplotype 1 of the sample.

mod-bedmethyl-hap2.title: Modified bases bedMethyl (haplotype 2)
mod-bedmethyl-hap2.description: BED file with the aggregated modification counts for haplotype 2 of the sample.

mod-bedmethyl-5mc-bigwig.title: 5mC bigWig
mod-bedmethyl-5mc-bigwig.description: Indexed bigWig signal track containing aggregated 5mC modification counts.

mod-bedmethyl-hap1-5mc-bigwig.title: 5mC bigWig (haplotype 1)
mod-bedmethyl-hap1-5mc-bigwig.description: Indexed bigWig signal track containing aggregated 5mC modification counts for haplotype 1 of the sample.

mod-bedmethyl-hap2-5mc-bigwig.title: 5mC bigWig (haplotype 2)
mod-bedmethyl-hap2-5mc-bigwig.description: Indexed bigWig signal track containing aggregated 5mC modification counts for haplotype 2 of the sample.

str-vcf.title: Short tandem repeat VCF
str-vcf.description: VCF file with the STR sites for the sample.

str-summary-tsv.title: Short tandem repeat genotype table
str-summary-tsv.description: Machine-readable TSV of merged STR calls produced by Straglr.

alignment.title: Alignment file
alignment.description: CRAM or BAM file with the aligned reads for the sample, generated when the input file is unaligned.

alignment-index.title: Alignment file index
alignment-index.description: The index of the resulting CRAM or BAM file with the reads for the sample, generated when the input file is unaligned.

haplotagged-alignment.title: Haplotagged alignment file
haplotagged-alignment.description: CRAM or BAM file of all input reads with haplotags added by phasing.

haplotagged-alignment-index.title: Haplotagged alignment file index
haplotagged-alignment-index.description: The index of the resulting CRAM or BAM file produced when haplotags have been added by phasing.

coverage-by-region.title: Mean coverage for each region
coverage-by-region.description: The mean coverage in the individual regions of the genome in BED format.

coverage-by-threshold.title: Coverage per region above the given thresholds
coverage-by-threshold.description: BED file containing the number of bases in each region covered at or above each threshold value (1x, 10x, 20x, and 30x).

distribution-of-coverage.title: Distribution of the proportion of total bases covered by a given coverage value
distribution-of-coverage.description: The cumulative distribution indicating the proportion of total bases covered by a given coverage value, both genome-wide and by sequence.

coverage-summary.title: Mean coverage per sequence and target region
coverage-summary.description: Machine-readable table of mean depths per chromosome and, when applicable, per target region.

coverage-per-base.title: BEDgraph of the single-base coverage
coverage-per-base.description: The single-base coverage of the genome in BED graph format.

bed-summary.title: BED summary
bed-summary.description: Tab separated table with the average coverage and percentage of positions that are covered to a given threshold, for each region specified in the `--bed` BED file. Only generated if the BED file has at least 4 columns, where the fourth column is the region label.

coverage-bed-summary.title: Coverage BED summary
coverage-bed-summary.description: Tab separated table with the average coverage and percentage of positions that are covered to a given threshold, for each region specified in the `--coverage_bed` BED file. Only generated if the BED file has at least 4 columns, where the fourth column is the region label.

haplocheck_output.title: Haplocheck contamination summary
haplocheck_output.description: A table generated by [haplocheck](https://mitoverse.readthedocs.io/haplocheck/haplocheck/), with estimate of contamination from the MT genome.
